title: usage.v1
description: FROZEN CONTRACT — do not edit without conductor approval. One provider-usage record: what a single agent spent on a single incident. Emitted by every model-backed agent and rolled up into the run's cost report. `usd` is computed from contracts/mesh/prices.json (per-million-token rates): usd = in_tokens/1e6 * in_per_m + out_tokens/1e6 * out_per_m. Reasoning tokens are billed at the output rate by every provider in prices.json, so include them in out_tokens AND report them separately in reasoning_tokens — reasoning_tokens is a breakdown of out_tokens, not an addition to it. `estimated: true` means the number came from prices.json arithmetic; false means the provider reported an authoritative cost.

agent.description: Canonical agent id: monitor, responder_claude, responder_codex, responder_antigravity, responder_kimi, or responder_glm.

model.description: Effective model id, as an OpenRouter id. Must be a key in contracts/mesh/prices.json for usd to be computable.

out_tokens.description: Output tokens billed, INCLUDING reasoning tokens.

reasoning_tokens.description: Reasoning tokens, reported separately as a breakdown of out_tokens. 0 when the runtime does not expose them.

usd.description: Cost in USD for this record.

estimated.description: True when usd was computed locally from prices.json; false when the provider returned an authoritative cost.

turns.description: Model turns (request/response round trips) this record covers.

incident_id.description: incident.v1.incident_id this spend is attributed to. Empty string for spend not tied to an incident (boot handshake, smoke test, idle monitoring).
